High-Level Committee on Demographic Changes to Survey India

A High-Level Committee on Demographic Changes will begin field surveys across India following a meeting with Union Home Minister Amit Shah. Phase 1 of Census 2027 has concluded successfully in Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh, according to Amit Sharma. Separately, Indian Railways has launched special Jammu-Srinagar train services for Amarnath Yatra pilgrims. In sports, four Jammu players won bronze medals at the North Zone Soft Tennis Championship. A cloudburst has forced the closure of the Zanskar-Manali road.
